in_hebrew.name: Gentry
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gentry הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English word 'genehten' meaning 'to enter'. The name Gentry can be translated to 'Entrance' or 'Gatekeeper'. In medieval England, the name was given to those who lived near an entrance to a castle or manor.
